A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VLA-Arena and include Appendices A–J. Their text, equations, tables, and rendered figures support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: V2 reports original simulation evaluations, perturbation experiments, ablations, failure analyses, and physical Franka robot results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V4 retains these original empirical studies and reports additional model evaluations in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The CBDDL framework, difficulty axes, safety-cost computation, and perturbation procedures remain unchanged. The corrected W1 instruction example in Section 2.3 does not alter the substitution procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 170 tasks across 11 suites, demonstration datasets, language and visual perturbations, LIBERO comparisons, and physical robot scenarios. The additional models are evaluated on retained task coverage.

E2.justification: V4 adds nine evaluated models: LingBot-VLA, LingBot-VLA 2.0, Motus, Evo-Depth, ACoT-VLA, DM0.5, GR00T-N1.7, MolmoAct2, and LangForce. This substantially expands the simulation comparison set. The Qwen OFT/GR00T comparisons previously duplicated in Table 8 remain in Table 7.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices F, H, and I retain the stated training splits, preprocessing, metrics, perturbation settings, and training budgets. No distinct protocol is documented for the added models, and numerical revisions do not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The perturbation probes, LIBERO instruction-removal experiment, data-diversity ablation, attention analysis, dynamic failure cases, and task-space analysis are retained. The data-diversity results move from Table 9 to Table 10; the new model tables add benchmark scores without new analytical questions.

E5.justification: Both versions specify 30 evaluation episodes per task, 10 per seed, and variance reporting across three seeds. V2 Table 31 and v4 Table 32 contain the same variance entries. No additional uncertainty estimates or statistical tests accompany the new models.

E6.justification: V4 Tables 8–9 add extensive SR and CC results, including ACoT-VLA's 0.62 TaskWorkflows L2 SR and MolmoAct2's 0.91 UnseenObjects L2 SR. Table 2 also revises existing costs: OpenVLA's HazardAvoidance L0 CC changes from 0.0 to 17.1. Appendix A replaces the latest-model finding of uniform near-zero collapse with degradation. Many other retained SR changes merely provide finer rounding.

T1.justification: The cumulative-cost definition, terminal penalty factor, CBDDL predicates and motion equations, perturbation distributions, and task-distance construction are unchanged. No new or revised proofs or formal assumptions appear.

C1.justification: The introduction changes the benchmark contribution from supporting architecture and algorithm research to being the first benchmark to structurally evaluate VLA performance and safety. This adds a specific priority claim; the abstract, principal findings, and conclusion otherwise retain their scope.

C2.justification: The explanations involving visual shortcuts, catastrophic forgetting, attention disruption, safety tradeoffs, and real-world applicability remain unchanged. Appendix A retains its universal skill-composition-bottleneck interpretation; its softened performance summary changes the reported finding rather than the explanatory argument.

D1.justification: The implementation descriptions, hyperparameter tables, preprocessing instructions, dataset construction, and framework access information are retained. No corresponding model-specific training or checkpoint details are added for the nine new comparators.

R1.justification: Eight references are added for newly evaluated models, including the LingBot, Motus, LangForce, and MolmoAct2 works. The introduction adds the performance-and-safety priority claim, while Table 1 and Appendix B retain the existing benchmark positioning and model taxonomy.

P1.justification: Edits are localized to author and affiliation information, the contribution sentence, Appendix A's model discussion, punctuation, and the W1 example. The main narrative and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: V4 restructures Table 8, adds a new Table 9, and relocates existing displays such as the data-diversity table and Figure 5. Table spacing and subsequent float placement change, but the existing figures and overall visual design are retained.

improvement.justification: The added comparisons make the benchmark more informative by documenting substantial success on some difficult tasks alongside persistent failures. Updated L0 safety costs improve consistency with the existing variance table, and Appendix A moderates its near-zero-collapse summary. The gains remain limited because the new models lack corresponding training and uncertainty documentation, and their stronger results receive little interpretive discussion.
